hints.validation: Check the card data and batch settings, then retry.
hints.badRequest: The server rejected the request. Check the parameters and retry.
hints.notFound: The requested resource was not found. Reload the page and try again.
hints.server: Retry later. If the error persists, contact the administrator.

errors.invalidStructure: The file structure does not match the expected one
errors.invalidSellerAttributes: Invalid JSON in the seller_attributes field
errors.noContent: The file has no description column

hints.emptyFile: Choose a file that contains at least one card.
hints.unsupportedFormat: Save the data as CSV, JSON or TSV and select the file again.
hints.fileTooLarge: Split the file into several smaller parts.
hints.readError: Check access to the file and try selecting it again.
hints.invalidJson: Fix the JSON syntax: check quotes, commas and brackets.
hints.invalidStructure: An array of objects is expected; for CSV — a header row and at least one data row.
hints.invalidSellerAttributes: The seller_attributes field must contain a valid JSON object, e.g. {"brand": "Bosch"}.
hints.noContent: Add a column named description (card description).
hints.noCards: Make sure the file contains data: card rows or a non-empty JSON array.

textInput.label: Card description
textInput.placeholder: e.g. manual coffee grinder, 38 mm steel burrs, 30 g capacity, black
textInput.hint: The pasted text becomes the description of a single card (the description field).

batch.title: Batch processing
batch.rangeError: Value out of range from {{min}} to {{max}}

validation.missingDescription: One or more records are missing a description.

hints.title: How to read the results
hints.threshold: Batch confidence threshold: {{threshold}}. Values below the threshold are highlighted and require review.
hints.thresholdUnknown: Values below the confidence threshold are highlighted and require review.
hints.columnLowConfidence: "Below threshold" — how many attributes of the card have confidence below the batch threshold.
hints.columnNeedsReview: "Review" — the card requires manual review due to low confidence or incomplete attributes.

status.ok: All required attributes are extracted and confirmed in the text.
status.low_confidence: Some values are below the threshold — review them manually before use.
status.partial: Only some of the required attributes were extracted.
status.error: Processing the card failed; the card can be processed again.
status.skipped: The card was skipped — no text was found to analyze.
